---
title: "adv2015_3"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
input <- readLines("advofcode3") %>% 
  str_split_1("")
input %>% 
  head(4)
```

```{r}
ruch_X <- c("^" = 0, "v" = 0, "<" = -1, ">" = 1)
ruch_y <- c("^" = 1, "v" = -1, "<" = 0, ">" = 0)
```

```{r}
tibble(x = cumsum(c(0, ruch_X[input])),
       y = cumsum(c(0, ruch_y[input]))) %>% 
  unique() %>% 
  nrow()
```

```{r}
input1 <- input[c(TRUE, FALSE)]
input2 <- input[c(FALSE, TRUE)]
```

```{r}
domy <- function(instr){
  tibble(x = cumsum(c(0, ruch_X[instr])),
       y = cumsum(c(0, ruch_y[instr])))
}
```

```{r}
domy(input1) %>% 
  bind_rows(domy(input2)) %>% 
  #rbind(domy(input2)) %>% 
  unique() %>% 
  nrow()
```
